text:
Maria: Heads-up — running into weird TLS drops when using REDWOOD_BASE_URL + PRIVATE_ENDPOINT behind our corp proxy. Streaming sessions cut after ~20s with EPROTO.
AJ: Which SDK + Node version? stacktrace?
Maria: Node 18.16, @redwood/sdk 1.14.2. Error: `Error: write EPROTO 140735...` only for streaming websocket/upgrade flows. Non-streaming REST calls succeed.
Chris: Got a snippet of init? small host/SNI differences can break long-lived TLS.
Maria: Minimal init: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  baseURL: process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL, // e.g. https://api.redwood.ai
  privateEndpoint: process.env.PRIVATE_ENDPOINT, // e.g. https://vpce-abc.internal
  agent: tunnelAgent, // corp tunneling agent
  streaming: true,
});
```
Streaming opens, tokens stream for a few seconds then socket closes with TLS handshake/write EPROTO.
Kevin: Two quick suspects: 1) proxy + mTLS + SNI mismatch for the upgrade path, 2) SDK fallback behavior where upgrade/ws path uses baseURL while other REST paths use privateEndpoint — causing Host vs SNI mismatch.
Sophia: If the TCP dest is vpce but Host header is api.redwood.ai, the proxy or vpce listener may reject once ALPN/SNI/virtual-host checks kick in. Can you tcpdump the SNI/Host?
Maria: Captured client logs: TCP dest = vpce-abc.internal but Host header = api.redwood.ai. So yup mismatch.
AJ: That matches. Short-term fix: set baseURL to your PRIVATE_ENDPOINT so Host/SNI align: `process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL = process.env.PRIVATE_ENDPOINT` before init.
Chris: Also try enabling keepAlive and tunnel options: `keepAlive: true`, `enableProxyTunnel: true` in the agent. Corp proxies often tear long-lived TLS if not tunneled.
Maria: Switched baseURL to PRIVATE_ENDPOINT and ran a 30m streaming test — stable. Workaround validated.
Kevin: We'll normalize precedence in the SDK: if privateEndpoint provided prefer it for streaming/upgrade flows or ensure Host header matches the SNI. I'll open a tracking issue.
devex-bot: Created ticket RW-4521: normalize endpoint precedence for streaming and improve proxy docs — https://redwood.internal/issue/RW-4521
Sophia: Note — Python SDK (requests) tends to set Host from the request URL so may not show this. Node HTTP agents can separate socket dest vs Host header leading to divergence.
Maria: FYI setting `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` suppressed errors but obviously not a fix. Don't do that in prod.
AJ: Action items:
• Kevin to file SDK PR for endpoint precedence for streaming (RW-4521)
• DevEx to add a short doc blurb about baseURL/privateEndpoint precedence + proxy tunnel tips
• Maria to paste minimal repro + tcpdump into RW-4521 (linked gist)
Maria: Pushed a minimal repro gist into the ticket: https://gist.github.com/maria/abc123
Chris: I'll add a unit/regression test and ping runtime infra about TLS termination behavior on the vpce listener.
Kevin: Quick rollback note for teams hitting this: set `REDWOOD_BASE_URL=PRIVATE_ENDPOINT` as an env var before client init.
Sophia: Also recommend adding a one-liner to onboarding: "If you're behind a proxy, prefer PRIVATE_ENDPOINT as the SDK base URL for streaming workloads." :memo:
Maria: Thanks all — saved my hair today :)
